correctness.rationale: The full powerset map U↦B_E,F(U) determines at each labeled world w the two inclusion-minimal true neighborhoods {E[w],F[w]}; incomparability ensures both occur, and rules out nontransverse alternative pairs. Form a loopless bipartite multigraph with each distinct recovered block as vertex and each world as labeled edge. Proper two-colorings correspond bijectively to all ordered E,F reconstructions; two blocks of the same color are disjoint, and each color partitions W. Components of this graph exactly encode E∨F components. A connected bipartite component has exactly two colorings, so fiber size is 2^c, and global agent swap quotient 2^(c-1). Every block must meet >=2 blocks of other color, so each component contains >=4 worlds, achieved by K2,2 grids with repeated cells; max 2^floor(n/4) and sharp first nonglobal at 8. Source partition checker covers all pairs through six worlds and explicit grids through 12 as corroboration; universal proof is graph reconstruction.
